7814.name: Seller product card GMV
7814.full_name: Seller product card gross merchandise value
7814.description: GMV generated by customers who purchased products through seller product cards on shop pages, search, or by browsing TikTok Shop. It includes shipping fees, but platform co-funding and seller promotions are subtracted. GMV doesn't subtract cancellations or refunds.

7816.name: Affiliate product card-attributed GMV
7816.full_name: Affiliate gross merchandise value attributed to product cards
7816.description: GMV generated by customers who clicked on creators' product card, such as showcase, and purchased the product directly or later.
7816.calc: Affiliate product card-attributed GMV = Affiliate product card GMV + Affiliate product card indirect GMV
